root: ^A brute in appearance, akin to an orc, yet strangely human somehow.
^ His arms were a maze of bulging veins and battle-worn scars, as though his flesh
^ had become a living shield through countless clashes.
^His journey to Ministeria was driven by a relentless quest —
^ to find a sword befitting his monstrous stature.
^For years, he traversed the land, growing increasingly disillusioned with the ornate steel blades
^ Legend whispers that in his frustration, he sculpted a colossal sword from a mere rock,
^ crafting a weapon as immense as himself.
^He named it Dragonrock, though scant evidence beyond a few frightened villagers' tales suggests its existence.
^Despite his fearsome appearance, he exhibited an unexpected kindness when intoxicated.
^In sobriety, however, he was a crude and discourteous fellow, lacking any semblance of etiquette.
^While not a criminal by nature, his very presence compelled people to bolt their doors and shutter
^ their windows whenever he drew near.
